subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Ler e compreender, em colaboração com os colegas e com a ajuda do professor e, mais tarde, de maneira autônoma, textos narrativos de maior porte como contos (populares, de fadas, acumulativos, de assombração etc.) e crônicas.

components.description_pt: Ler textos de prosa do ano com apoio de adulto ou colega
components.description_en: Read grade-level prose texts with prompting and support from an adult or peer
components.cc_component_description: Read grade-level prose texts with prompting and support from an adult or peer

components.description_pt: Ler textos literários complexos independentemente com compreensão no nível apropriado
components.description_en: Read complex literary texts independently with comprehension at the appropriate grade band
components.cc_component_description: Read complex literary texts independently with comprehension at the appropriate grade band

components.description_pt: Compreender textos narrativos de gêneros como contos de fadas, fábulas e crônicas
components.description_en: Comprehend narrative texts from genres such as folk tales, fairy tales, and chronicles
components.cc_component_description: Analyze key ideas and supporting details in narrative texts

cc_matches.description: Read and comprehend complex literary and informational texts independently and proficiently.
With prompting and support, read prose and poetry of appropriate complexity for grade 1.

Por medio de su repertorio lingüístico y utilizando artefactos multimodales, los estudiantes bi/multilingües podrán interpretar relatos para...
* intuir el contexto de cuentos e historias
* discernir las secuencias de tiempo y eventos en historias y cuentos
* identificar lenguaje que atrae a la audiencia
* determinar el significado literal y no literal de palabras y frases
* distinguir acciones específicas de personajes y eventos
* analizar ideas y detalles de textos
